locations.note: The squadron covers the evacuation of Dunkirk in 1940.
The Battle of Britain, dogfights over London against a German ace.
Desert sorties in support of the British in Libya.
Scrambling into the air as the Japanese strike Pearl Harbor.
Hunting a Japanese carrier convoy in the Coral Sea.
Defending the airfield at Midway from Japanese raids.
Beating off Japanese landings at Guadalcanal.
The squadron covers the bombers over Rabaul, then wrecks the rest of the Japanese base.
A strike on German shipping in Norway and the heavy-water plant in the mountains.
Covering the D-Day landings from the air, where Joe is shot down and killed.
Ground support during the liberation of Paris.
Swarms of Luftwaffe fighters over the Ardennes in the Battle of the Bulge.
The final mission over Berlin in 1945 against German jet fighters.
